name: relaunch
description: Remember working sets of terminal tabs (folders, commands, Claude sessions) and bring them back after a restart, one short command per tab
long_description: Keeps named sets of members -- a folder, a command with its arguments, a shell script, or a Claude Code session (through csb) -- and records which terminal tab has claimed which member and what was open last session. After a restart, each fresh tab runs `dz relaunch <set> claim` (or `claim -o` to run the member there): the next member, last session's first. Claims expire on their own when a tab closes or the machine restarts. Restores folders and programs, not scrollback, layout or splits.
